definitionZh: 读取流 CSS 属性可以修改块,弹性或网格布局中孩子元素的读取顺序. 这影响到在使用顺序导航(例如对链接或按钮的触动)时,将其用于语音和导航的顺序。
sourceDefinition: The reading-flow CSS property enables modifying the reading order of child elements of a block, flex, or grid layout. This affects the order in which they are rendered to speech and navigated to when using sequential navigation such as tabbing to links or buttons.
